verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of native, in-product AI insights or suggestions. The closest path is the official Kit MCP server, which exposes live account data (subscribers, broadcasts, segments) to an external MCP-compatible AI client, combined with stats endpoints for broadcast, link-click, email and growth performance. An outside AI tool could analyze that data, but this requires an extra tool and happens outside the product. Subscriber engagement scoring is listed, but nothing says it is AI-generated. missing for 10: native in-app AI insight or suggestion features, evidence that engagement scoring is AI-driven, documentation of AI-generated recommendations from account data, hands-on corroboration.
